messages:
sam: quick heads-up — need a short merge window for PR #10421 (batch backoff + retry fixes). Unit tests + bench look good but one integration test is flaky. Freeze starts in ~3h. Can someone rerun CI and/or grant a one-off pre-freeze slot?

ci-bot: CI report: 1 flaky integration failure (test_ingest_timeout). Failure occurs intermittently at p99. Rerun command: ```/retest-integration --pr 10421```

maria: I can review and approve if the rerun comes back clean. @sam please assign me as reviewer and add a short changelog blurb. :+1:

kevin: Heads-up from release side — freeze policy allows low-risk perf/infra changes with manual approval, but we should avoid touching anything that changes rollout hooks. Can you confirm this only affects client-side backoff?

sam: yes — purely server-side batching backoff tweak, no schema or rollout hooks touched. The patch reduces tokenization stalls at high concurrency (we saw ~20% tail latency reduction in staging). Low-risk by our metrics.

julia: I can take the rebase if you need. If you push a rebased branch with conflicts resolved I will run a local CI pass and push. Otherwise I can do it after CI green.

kevin: If everyone signs off I'm fine with a short pre-freeze landing. @release-bot do we need formal override?

release-bot: Prefreeze policy: manual approval required for non-critical changes. Add a release note and get two approvers. If both reviewers approve, tag with `prefreeze-approved` and ops will allow a merge window.

maria: Approved after rerun — requested a tiny changelog in PR description.

sam: running `/retest-integration --pr 10421` now. pinging @kevin for final canary signoff once CI green. :rocket:

ci-bot: Rerun queued. Current status: integration (queued) — will post back when complete.

kevin: I'll do the canary signoff once integration is green and smoke tests pass on canary. Standby.

sam: thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. if anything blocks I'll update this thread. :pray:
